title: Real-Time Update Checker with GitHub Changelog & Pull/Rebuild Alerts
message: feat(updater): implement live update detection with changelog and pull/rebuild guide
changelog: Replaced hardcoded update modal with live GitHub repository update checker
Display update notification banner and commit change message when newer version is detected
Added copyable terminal commands for git pull and rebuild (frontend & backend)
Added statusbar update notification pill for unobtrusive background update alerts
Created version.json and /api/system/check-update endpoint for automated release tracking
